title: A Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Novel Pharmacotherapy for Heart Failure
abstract: Background: Chronic heart failure requires evidence-based regimens. Methods: In this double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled parallel-group trial, 620 participants were randomly assigned to pharmacotherapy or placebo. Results: The primary composite endpoint was significantly reduced. Conclusions: The agent was safe and efficacious.
discussion: In contrast to our clear prospective findings, previous meta-analyses and systematic reviews in the observational literature had yielded inconclusive and contradictory results regarding class efficacy.
